title: SDG 16-1-1: Victims of Intentional Homicide
description: Number of victims of intentional homicide per 100,000 population by sex, as per the specifications of SDG Indicator 16-1-1.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency.

fields.name: sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: [Categorical] Either both sexes ('both'), male ('male') or female ('female')

fields.name: value
fields.title: Victims per 100,000 Population
fields.description: [Float] The number of victims of intentional homicide per 100,000 population

methodology: This dataset is produced based on the individual-level administrative records collected by the Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM), which is the single source of truth for data on crimes in Malaysia. Besides for operational purposes, this data is reported as part of Malaysia's monitoring of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), in line with the most recent [SDG Global Indicator Framework](https://storage.dosm.gov.my/technotes/sdg.pdf).
caveat: The data is subject to revision in future updates.
